close_reason: Done together with ag-s99.4: EqualFold on owner/repository, canonical spelling from the token.
description: From review of ag-s99.3 (2026-10-14). The unique index migrations/006_unique_deployment.sql folds case for owner and repository, but verifyIdentity (internal/core/runbinding.go) and Webhook (internal/core/worker.go) compare Owner+"/"+Repository exactly. A deployment registered as ACME/agent never matches runs whose OIDC token says acme/agent (true before ag-s99.3 too). Fix: compare case-insensitively, or store GitHub's canonical name. With ag-s99.4 the deployment is created from the token, which makes the canonical name the natural choice; do it there or after. Check: go test ./... with AGBREDO_TEST_DATABASE_URL.
title: Match repository names case-insensitively
